blocks.x: Ad and martech businesses trade on identity, measurement and trust: signal loss (cookie deprecation, ATT), clean-room measurement and consent architecture decide whether targeting survives the privacy era — and whether spend proves incrementality.

The workflows we industrialize here: Identity resolution, Audience activation, Measurement/incrementality, Creative operations, Fraud detection. Each arrives with its current cycle times measured in the Diagnose phase, and each leaves the program governed by outcome SLOs rather than anecdotes.

items: Third-party identifiers deprecate; first-party identity graphs inconsistent across systems.
Invalid traffic and fraud schemes persist; measurement unverified.
CDP/activation stacks duplicate data; costs rise with fragmentation.
Attribution wars persist; incrementality rarely tested.
